reasons: CS2105 requires CS2040 (or equivalent) which is not completed and cannot be taken in Sem 7 or 8 as it requires CS1010 (assumed completed) but typically taken earlier; however, even if taken in Sem 7, CS4248 requires CS2109S/CS3244 etc. and Math prerequisites (MA1511/1512 or MA2002) which are not listed as completed.

The student has not completed the necessary prerequisites for CS2105 (e.g., CS2040) or CS4248 (e.g., CS2109S, Math courses). Without these completed or planned in earlier semesters, the courses cannot be taken.
It is impossible to satisfy the requirement that CS4248 is in Sem 8 and CS2105 is taken before it, given the missing prerequisites for both courses in the current context.
